items.headline: Cam Miller's 88-yard pick-6 highlights Kennesaw State's 26-7 win over Sam Houston
items.description: — Landon Varnes threw for 181 yards and a touchdown, Cam Miller had an 88-yard pick-6 and Kennesaw State beat Sam Houston 26-7 on Saturday for its third straight Conference USA victory.

items.headline: Varnes' 63-yard TD pass to Jesiolowski helps Kennesaw State outlast Delaware 42-40
